meta.direction: TUNIC-inspired: faceted UI layer and faceted, toy-proportioned 3D art direction (authored), over the repo's exact tokens

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Page ground. Deep: the app's `--deep` (html background, theme-color). Paper: the logo's cream field (#F3F4EE, brand/currents-logo.jpg) — the storybook-manual ground for any printed-page surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `deep`, `glass`, `panel` (15.5:1 / 10.2:1 deep; 10.5:1 paper). Paper value sampled from the logo's wordmark.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text — hints, captions, blurbs, seed — on `deep` and `panel` (7.0:1 / 4.6:1 deep; 5.6:1 / 5.8:1 paper). Never on `panel-hi`.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Translucent fill for HUD controls floating over the live ocean (with backdrop-filter blur 6–9px). Source `--glass`.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Hairline on glass surfaces at rest. Decorative only — below 3:1, so never the only boundary of a control; pair with `edge-solid` or a facet lip.

tokens.name: edge-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/focus edge on the trigger and picker cards (source literal).

tokens.name: edge-current
tokens.usage: Edge of the currently chosen picker card (source literal).

tokens.name: accent-sea
tokens.usage: Volume slider accent-color, links, the sea-glass highlight. 7.2:1 on `panel` deep; paper value is the logo mark's mid blue.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Solid face of a faceted tile — dialog panel, picker card, keycap. Deep value is the boot gradient's middle stop.

tokens.name: panel-hi
tokens.usage: The lit top facet: a 3px band along the top edge of every faceted tile (the boot gradient's top stop). Decorative — no text sits on it.

tokens.name: panel-lo
tokens.usage: The shadowed bottom lip: a 4px band along the bottom edge of a faceted tile, which is what makes it read as a chunky little block sitting on the table.

tokens.name: edge-solid
tokens.usage: Outline of a faceted control, drawn along the chamfered edges too (4.8:1 on `deep`, 3.2:1 on `panel` deep; 3.2:1 paper).

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: The moss-green accent: selected state, the current animal, primary action fills. Deep value is the brightest kelp colour. 8.8:1 on `deep`; paper 4.6:1.

tokens.name: on-leaf
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `leaf` fill (8.3:1 deep, 5.1:1 paper).

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Warm sunlight gold: the focus ring (solid 2px, 12.5:1 on `deep`, 8.3:1 on `panel`), keycap letters, a lit highlight. Deep value is the seabed sand.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text on a `sun` fill (10:1 deep, 5.9:1 paper).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Warm coral accent for marks — the sound-on dot, a badge, a cover block. Deep: 4.3:1 on `panel`, so marks and 24px+ text only.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Dusk/night accent (the coral palette's violet): night-time states, secondary marks. Deep: 3.6:1 on `panel` — marks and 24px+ text only.

tokens.name: world-shallow
tokens.usage: Water tint and fog just under the surface (WATER.shallowColor).

tokens.name: world-deep-water
tokens.usage: Fog at the seabed — depth reads bluer, never black (WATER.deepColor).

tokens.name: world-ground-light
tokens.usage: Hemisphere light's downward colour (WATER.groundColor).

tokens.name: world-surface-glow
tokens.usage: Snell's window, the bright disc overhead (WATER.surfaceGlow).

tokens.name: world-surface-mirror
tokens.usage: The mirrored ceiling past the critical angle (WATER.surfaceMirror).

tokens.name: world-fill
tokens.usage: Counter fill light (WATER.fillColor).

tokens.name: world-shaft
tokens.usage: Light shafts at noon (lightShafts / DAY).

tokens.name: world-caustic

tokens.name: world-sand

tokens.name: creature-eye
tokens.usage: Every animal's eyes — a solid near-black dot, no catchlight, no pupil (species.ts EYE).

tokens.name: creature-belly
tokens.usage: PROPOSED shared warm-cream belly for all four animals (the logo's cream, a touch warmer) — replaces the cool whites #e9f1f3 / #f3f8fa / #dfecf3, so the undersides read cosy rather than clinical.

tokens.name: whale-back
tokens.usage: Humpback back colour (source).

tokens.name: whale-tip
tokens.usage: PROPOSED dark tips: fluke trailing edge, dorsal hump, rostrum knobs.

tokens.name: whale-accent
tokens.usage: The whale's one graphic accent: pale pectorals (source device, now `creature-belly`).

tokens.name: dolphin-back
tokens.usage: Dolphin back colour (source); its darker cape is this × 0.66.

tokens.name: dolphin-tip
tokens.usage: PROPOSED dark tips: dorsal fin, fluke, beak tip.

tokens.name: manta-back
tokens.usage: Manta back colour (source).

tokens.name: manta-tip
tokens.usage: Manta wingtips — source darkens the back by 0.42 at the outer fifth of the span; this is that value, now a hard facet band.

tokens.name: turtle-shell
tokens.usage: Turtle carapace (source).

tokens.name: turtle-plastron
tokens.usage: Turtle underside (source).

tokens.name: turtle-flipper
tokens.usage: Turtle flippers (source).

tokens.name: turtle-tip
tokens.usage: PROPOSED scute seams and flipper tips, as whole darker facets.

styles.name: title-word
styles.usage: The title card's word, uppercase, text-indent 0.16em to recentre the tracking. Source size; Fredoka 500 replaces system 300.

styles.name: trigger-name
styles.usage: The animal name inside the trigger.

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: HUD hints and meta line; key words in `ink` weight 700.

styles.name: blurb
styles.sample: All wing. Flies more than it swims.

styles.name: foot
styles.sample: The swim carries on — you keep your place, heading and speed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Pill inner padding (sound control).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a control's parts; HUD end column gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Picker card grid gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; HUD meta gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between HUD hints.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen-edge inset for the HUD at desktop (clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.6rem)); panel padding max 1.9rem.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Source: stats panel. In the faceted direction, use `bevel-sm` instead.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Source: picker cards. Faceted: `bevel-md`.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Source: picker panel. Faceted: `bevel-lg`.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Source: trigger and sound pills. Faceted: an octagon with `bevel-md` corners.

bevel.note: The polygon language: corner chamfer sizes for clip-path octagons. Every tile is cut, never rounded.

tokens.name: bevel-xs
tokens.usage: Keycaps and small badges.

tokens.name: bevel-sm
tokens.usage: Stats panel, sound toggle.

tokens.name: bevel-md
tokens.usage: Trigger, picker cards, buttons.

tokens.name: bevel-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog panels and the title-card plinth.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Picker panel lift (source). With clip-path, apply as filter: drop-shadow on a wrapper.

tokens.name: shadow-mark
tokens.usage: Title-card logo mark, as drop-shadow (source).

form.note: PROPOSED 3D form targets for the faceted, toy-like look. Multipliers are relative to the current constants in src/creatures/species.ts; counts replace the current segment counts.

tokens.name: body-radial
tokens.usage: Radial segments on every swept body (was 20–30). Odd-ish, low counts are what make facets read.

tokens.name: body-segments
tokens.usage: Lengthwise body segments (whale 46, dolphin 44, turtle 34). Keep enough for the swim wave to bend smoothly — 12 is the floor.

tokens.name: fin-chord
tokens.usage: chordSegments on foils, flukes and wing discs (default 9).

tokens.name: eye-segments
tokens.usage: Eyes as SphereGeometry(r, 6, 4) — a tiny faceted bead.

tokens.name: eye-scale
tokens.usage: Multiply every eye radius (whale 0.14, dolphin 0.07, manta 0.10, turtle 0.08) and lift the eye pair slightly up and forward.

tokens.name: head-scale
tokens.usage: Front third of the body bulked up — a bigger head/forebody is the main cute lever.

tokens.name: body-length-scale
tokens.usage: Shorten bodies (whale 15 → 12.3, dolphin 6.6 → 5.4, manta length 7.6 → 6.2) while keeping height, so animals read stout. Scale viewDistance with it.

tokens.name: limb-scale
tokens.usage: Shorten secondary fins and flippers (dorsal, turtle flippers, dolphin beak) — but NOT the signature shape (whale pectorals, manta wingspan).

tokens.name: terrain-res
tokens.usage: WORLD.chunkRes (was 48 → 2m quads), so the seabed reads as big flat facets.

tokens.name: prop-sphere
tokens.usage: Width segments for coral lobes and domes (was 12; height segments 5 was 8).

tokens.name: rock-detail
tokens.usage: IcosahedronGeometry detail for rocks (was 1): 20 faces, a proper chunky boulder.

tokens.name: face-jitter
tokens.usage: ± lightness jitter per face on terrain and props, so neighbouring facets separate like hand-painted planes.
